subject: Trading
title: Delta: Direction Sensitivity
description: A fast breakdown of Delta: Direction Sensitivity for builders.

hook.text: Your option has a delta of 0.50. The stock rises $1. Your option gains $0.50. Delta measures directional sensitivity.

buildup.text: Delta ranges from 0 to 1 for calls and 0 to -1 for puts. Higher delta means more sensitivity to price changes.

discovery.text: ATM options have about 0.50 delta. Deep ITM options approach 1.0—they move almost dollar-for-dollar with stock.

twist.text: Delta also approximates the probability of expiring in the money. A 0.30 delta option has roughly 30% chance.

climax.text: Traders use delta to gauge how many shares of exposure an option position represents.

punchline.text: Delta tells you how much your option cares about price.

quiz.question: What does a delta of 0.50 mean?
options: The option gains about $0.50 for every $1 move in the stock
